messages:
Ava (Finance): FYI invoice #98732 (ProHealth Labs) auto-ACH failed — bank returned "account name mismatch". Amount $62,400. Need decision: manual retry/collect new ACH or wire? Also needs finance approval for wire.
Darren (Billing Ops): Got it. Can you paste the Stripe failure event id?
Ava (Finance): stripe_evt_3K8aWqX — bank reply text: "account_name_mismatch: beneficiary_name does not match account holder".
billing-bot: Payment method update detected for cust: prohealth-labs, last4: ****2345, event: payment_failed
Darren (Billing Ops): Checking audit — customer originally provided ACH under name "ProHealth Labs Inc" vs bank holds "Pro Health Labs". Microdeposit flow never completed.
Priya (CS): I just reached out to the customer: asking if they'd prefer to re-provide ACH or send wire. Want to avoid placing them on PR/credit hold if possible.
Ava (Finance): If customer can do wire we'll need PO + signed SOW and Hector approval for >$50k. If ACH, ask them to confirm legal name and complete microdeposit verification (re-initiate).
Darren (Billing Ops): Quick logs:
```
Stripe failure: type=bank_account_rejected, code=account_name_mismatch
metadata: invoice=98732, amount=62400
```
Darren (Billing Ops): If we do manual retry we should hold for 24h and not attempt >2 times to avoid bank block.
Priya (CS): Customer on call in 30m, I'll confirm wire routing and whether treasurer can send PDF of wire (remittance).
Ava (Finance): Tagging Hector — @Hector can you approve wire release if they provide PO+SOW and proof of funds? Also do we need AML check?
Hector (Finance Dir): Approved to proceed with wire once PO + signed SOW + bank remittance PDF received. AML: perform standard vendor AML check; confirm beneficiary matches SOW.
Darren (Billing Ops): Will prepare temporary credit hold memo for accounts receivable. Also creating support ticket for microdeposit instructions: https://app.redwood/billing/tickets/3482
Priya (CS): Customer will send remittance within 2 hours. If we get PDF I'll DM Darren and Ava.
Ava (Finance): Thanks — once we have docs I'll open manual payout request and mark invoice as pending-wire. Keep thread updated.
billing-bot: Manual payout request created: payout_5591, status=pending_review
Darren (Billing Ops): Note for audit: record reason=bank_name_mismatch; attempts=1; next_action=await_docs
Priya (CS): Closing this side — will add transcript after call.
Ava (Finance): End of thread for now :+1:
